docs.summary: A keyframed curve with one to four components per key.
docs.remarks:
Keys are always sorted by time and stored in flat float arrays, so evaluation walks contiguous memory and a curve imported from a glTF sampler can adopt the accessor buffers without copying. [`Keyframe`](#api~Prowl.Vector.Keyframe) is a view over that storage: reading an index materialises a copy, so edits must be written back through the indexer or [`MoveKey`](#api~Prowl.Vector.AnimationCurve~MoveKey).

Interpolation is per key and governs the segment leaving it, which is what lets a single curve mix stepped and smooth sections. Tangents are slopes in value units per second (the glTF and Unity convention), so retiming keys does not change the shape of the handles.

Evaluates the curve as a rotation. Linear segments use spherical interpolation and cubic segments are renormalised, both matching glTF. Neither [`CycleOffset`](#api~Prowl.Vector.CurveWrapMode~CycleOffset) nor [`Extrapolate`](#api~Prowl.Vector.CurveWrapMode~Extrapolate) means anything for a rotation, so the first behaves as [`Loop`](#api~Prowl.Vector.Geometry.GeometryData.Loop) and the second as [`Clamp`](#api~Prowl.Vector.CurveWrapMode~Clamp).

exceptions.text: Thrown when the curve does not have four components.

docs.summary: Flips whole keys so no two adjacent rotations are more than a half turn apart, treating the curve as a sequence of quaternions.
docs.remarks:
A quaternion and its negation are the same rotation, and exporters are free to emit either, so a sign flip between adjacent keys is common and means nothing. It matters anyway: [`CubicSpline`](#api~Prowl.Vector.CurveInterpolation~CubicSpline) interpolates the four components independently, and across a flip that sweeps the long way round instead of the short one. Slerp handles the flip itself, so a purely linear curve does not need this, but calling it is harmless.

Tangents are flipped with their key, since a tangent is a rate of change of the value it belongs to.

exceptions.text: Thrown when the curve does not have four components.
